content: वरणम् [वृ-ल्युट् ल्यु वा <ls>Uṇ. 2. 71</ls>] .²1 Choosing, selecting. .²2 Begging, soliciting, requesting. .²3 Surrounding, encircling. .²4 Covering, screening, protecting. .²5 The choice of a bride. .²6 Worshipping (of priests <ab>&c.</ab>). .²7 Keeping off, prohibiting, warding. .{@-णः@} .²1 A rampart, surrounding wall; वरणः कनकस्य मानिनीं दिवमङ्कादमराद्रिरागताम् … … उवास <ls>N. 2. 86</ls>. .²2 A bridge. .²3 The tree called Varuṇa; <ls>Rām. 2. 94. 9</ls>; see वरुण (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>वायवर्णा</ns>). .²4 A tree in general; इह सिन्धवश्च वरणावरणाः करिणां मुदे सनलदानलदाः <ls>Ki. 5. 25</ls>. .²5 A camel. .²6 A kind of ornament on a bow. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of Indra. .²8 A particular magical formula recited over weapons.
